## Changes

- Skip string metadata candidates that overlap ELF bookkeeping tables, with a warning instead of aborting the import.
- Preserve the existing table data, labels and comments. Other string-import conflicts still fail.
- Recover shared and reference-generic call types when the required metadata is available, including delegate receivers returned by those calls.
- Use up to eight workers for interface and delegate call analysis.
- Support generated filename hashes when matching classes, and check runtime layout confidence before layout-dependent call analysis.
- Add synthetic regression tests for table types, byte order, pointer-slot boundaries and malformed extents.

## Known limitation

Il2CppDumper metadata does not identify each method's assembly. Fallback class matching can still include framework methods or skip ambiguous matches. This release does not fix that limitation.
